verdict.rationale: Superhuman's calendar docs show the calendar inside the client. You can add and toggle Gmail/Outlook calendars, a side panel shows your day when an email mentions a date, and you can add a secondary time zone. 'Find Time' and Team Scheduling show teammate availability, which implies in-client scheduling, but event creation itself is never explicitly described. Nothing in the pack covers responding to invites (RSVP). The MCP 'schedule meetings' claim runs through external AI assistants, not inside the email client, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of accepting or declining invites in the client, explicit documentation of creating events in the client, independent or hands-on corroboration.
